summary_ja: 産業利用上位のOpenFOAMについて、OpenCFD v2606の初期GPU offload、別開発track、結果差、v2612統合目標と、Foundation v14という別配布系列を追加しました。製品名だけでGPU対応を判定しません。単一モデルによる暫定調査でConsensusは未完了です。
summary_en: For the prominent industrial package OpenFOAM, this update adds OpenCFD v2606's initial GPU offload, separate development track, result differences, and v2612 integration target, while distinguishing the separate Foundation v14 distribution. GPU support is not inferred from the product name alone. This is provisional single-model research with Consensus incomplete.

items.statement_ja: OpenCFD/KeysightのOpenFOAM v2606は、C++17/20 execution policyとUMPIRE memory管理を用いる初のGPU offload対応を公表しました。field algebra、linear solver、boundary evaluation等の低層loopを対象とし、AMD・NVIDIAと共同開発しています。一方、GPU codeはmain development lineとは別trackで、選定caseによる試験段階です。CPU版とGPU版でtruncation errorにより結果がわずかに異なると明記し、v2612への統合を将来目標としています。OpenFOAM Foundationは別にv14を2026年7月14日に公開しており、同じ『OpenFOAM最新版』として一括しません。
items.statement_en: OpenCFD/Keysight's OpenFOAM v2606 announces its first GPU-offload support using C++17/20 execution policies and UMPIRE memory management. Developed with AMD and NVIDIA, it targets low-level loops including field algebra, linear solvers, and boundary evaluation. The GPU code nevertheless remains on a separate track from the main development line and has been tested on selected cases. The project notes small CPU-versus-GPU result differences from truncation error and targets integration in v2612. Separately, the OpenFOAM Foundation released v14 on July 14, 2026; the two lines must not be collapsed into one 'latest OpenFOAM' record.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 利用頻度の高いCFD codeのGPU readinessは製品名ではなく、配布系列、release、solver、physics、precision、caseごとに判定する必要があります。
items.hpci_relevance_en: GPU readiness for a heavily used CFD code must be determined by distribution line, release, solver, physics, precision, and case rather than product name alone.
adoption_conditions_ja: HPCI利用報告で使用されたOpenFOAM系列、version、solver、libraryを特定する。
同一mesh・境界条件でCPU/GPUの収束、保存量、結果差、elapsed time、energyを測る。
v2612統合後にsource差分、build、multi-node GPU通信、restart、plugin互換性を再検証する。
adoption_conditions_en: Identify OpenFOAM distribution line, version, solver, and libraries used in HPCI reports.
Measure convergence, conserved quantities, result differences, elapsed time, and energy on CPU and GPU with identical meshes and boundary conditions.
After v2612 integration, revalidate source differences, builds, multi-node GPU communication, restart, and plugin compatibility.
